title: Quiet 1 bedroom in the heart of East Nashville
description:
Perfect location to live like a local or explore like a tourist. Walking distance to the shops, restaurants, and entertainment of the hippest place in Nashville, 5 Points. 1 mile to Nissan stadium. 1 mile to Shelby park.  You can spend your entire time within walking distance of your place living like a local or hop in a 5 minute Uber and have everything downtown offers at your fingertips.

The space
Private one bedroom, one bathroom, 650 sq ft apartment with full kitchen and laundry in the unit.  It’s a home broken into three 1 bedroom units. The other two units have long term tenants.
